predictions.rationale: The change request involves modifying the translation of POM to Ivy XML, which affects the ResolveEngine class. This class is crucial for resolving dependencies, so it is likely to be impacted.
The ResolveEngine class interacts with IvyNode, which represents a node in the dependency graph. Changes to ResolveEngine may require corresponding changes to IvyNode.
The change request involves modifying the translation of POM to Ivy XML. The XmlModuleDescriptorParser class is responsible for parsing XML files, so it is likely to be impacted.
The Ivy class is the main entry point for Ivy, and it interacts with various components including ResolveEngine and IvyNode. Changes to the translation process may require modifications to Ivy.

The change request involves modifying the translation of POM to Ivy XML, which affects the caching mechanism. The DefaultRepositoryCacheManager class is responsible for caching artifacts, so it is likely to be impacted.
The ModuleDescriptor class represents a module descriptor, which is used to describe a module. Changes to the translation process may require modifications to ModuleDescriptor.
The DefaultModuleDescriptor class is a concrete implementation of ModuleDescriptor. Changes to the translation process may require modifications to DefaultModuleDescriptor.
The Artifact class represents an artifact, which is a file produced by a module. Changes to the translation process may require modifications to Artifact.
The DefaultArtifact class is a concrete implementation of Artifact. Changes to the translation process may require modifications to DefaultArtifact.
The ModuleRevisionId class represents a module revision ID, which uniquely identifies a module revision. Changes to the translation process may require modifications to ModuleRevisionId.
